text:
omar_sales: GreenHaven procurement sent over their PO template. Main asks: PO# on every invoice line, separate invoice per subsidiary, MSA signed before any billing. Can we support?
tara_legal: MSA-first is fine. Need signer list per legal entity. They also attached a DPA with extra KMS/HSM language 12 which we'll need to redline.
mei_cs: This is a Dedicated POC that will roll into Reserved capacity. Procurement also asked for a POC credit line so they don't get auto-charged.
jordan_ops: We can emit multiple invoices keyed by billing_entity_id and include po_number per line. Small billing schema change required (add po_line_id). Ops estimate: 1 business day to change schema + template.
viv_finance: Standard pilot terms are net30 + deposit. Customer wants net45 and no deposit. Finance prefers 50% deposit. If legal allows net45 conditioned on deposit, we can approve.
tara_legal: Draft KMS clause: "Customer-managed keys allowed; Redwood will not have access to private key material. Audit scope for keys to be mutually agreed. Redwood remains responsible for runtime availability." If they push broader liability we escalate.
omear_sales: They also want 12-month price protection for SKUs on the order form and PO binding on day 0.
mei_cs: I'll add a line: "POC credit -$X (applies to pilot)" in the order form so billing flags it.
jordan_ops: DocuSign plan: single MSA envelope for consolidated signature by customer execs, then per-entity order form envelopes referencing the MSA ID. That keeps audit trail and matches invoices.
docusign-bot: template created (tmpl-gh-msacomp). Please review signers.
tara_legal: Need signer mapping table in the envelope: Customer Exec -> MSA; Procurement -> Order Form; Finance -> PO acknowledgement. Also attach SOC2 + subprocessor list as requested.
viv_finance: If deposit is 50% at countersign and remainder on first invoice net45, finance can accept net45 for pilot.
omar_sales: Action items: 1) @tara_legal finalize redline and send snippet (EOD), 2) @jordan_ops ship billing schema + DocuSign templates (1 business day), 3) @viv_finance confirm deposit text, 4) @mei_cs attach SOC2/subprocessors and prepare envelopes.
docusign-bot: envelope (env_gh_2002) created for review. omar_sales: pls QA and send when ready.
